meta.name: general-video
meta.description: The fallback workflow for authoring or editing any custom HyperFrames composition at any length or format — longer / multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, title cards, static loops, freeform builds. Use only when no specialized workflow fits the input; routing table at /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创作或编辑任意长度的视频合成作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作多场景视频或品牌短片
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit video compositions of any length
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce multi-scene videos or brand sizzle reels

howto.what: Claude 会帮你制作或编辑自定义视频，包括长片、品牌宣传片、蒙太奇、标题卡、静态循环等。它会先理解需求，然后设计视觉风格、规划结构，最后生成 HTML 代码。
howto.when: 当你的需求不适合其他专门工作流（如产品发布、网站转视频等）时触发。通常在你提出制作或编辑视频的要求时接管。

say.text: 帮我做一个品牌宣传片，时长30秒。
给这个视频加一个标题卡。
say.note: Claude 会直接进入构建阶段，跳过前期规划。

say.text: 把第三场景的时长调整到5秒。
say.note: Claude 会直接修改指定场景的时长。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you create or edit custom videos, including long-form pieces, brand reels, montages, title cards, static loops, and freeform builds. It understands your request, designs the visual identity, plans the structure, and generates HTML code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when your request does not fit a specialized workflow (e.g., product launch, website-to-video). Typically activates when you ask to create or edit a video.

say_en.text: Create a 30-second brand reel for our company.
Add a title card to this video.
say_en.note: Claude will skip planning and go straight to building.

say_en.text: Change the duration of scene 3 to 5 seconds.
say_en.note: Claude will directly modify the specified scene's timing.
